Crawl with browser mode 'always' follows links using browser rendering

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"},\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.CrawlAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Pages.Count);
Console.WriteLine(result.BrowserUsed);
```
